== V3.e ==

New Workshop: Painter's Workshop

* The Painter can recolor 10 pieces of furniture and blocks(4).
* You have 8 colors available. White, Black, Brown, Yellow, Red, Green, Blue and Purple.
* Paint is made from dye, each bag of dye gives you 10 units of paint.
* Meph decided to make the amount this high because people will have to recolor a lot of items and since it's purely ornamental it doesnt break the gamebalance to allow 10 instead of just 1 item to be colored.

==Painting==
You can recolor furniture and blocks in this workshop. Dye can be converted into 10 units of paint.

Dwarves have access to 8 colors, black, white, yellow, brown, green, purple, blue and red. Furniture is painted one by one, blocks in batches of 4. Together with the brick oven, this should allow complete control over colorization. OCD begone.
